summary: Corporate cage-free campaigns for laying hens in Latin America and Southeast Asia (Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Indonesia, Peru, Thailand): new commitments won from 2024 to mid-2026, Arcor's above all, and accountability work on older ones. A re-implementation of Animal Charity Evaluators' 2026 cost-effectiveness sheet for its Laying Hens programme, 59% of Sinergia's spending.

sections.title: In chicken pain days
sections.explainer: charityevals' standard step for every animal model, not ACE's. Ambitious Impact's suffering-adjusted days (SADs) count each species' pain as a share of a person's, using its own species weights. Here those weights come out and Rethink Priorities' estimates go in, so every species is counted in days of a chicken's disabling pain. How a chicken's suffering compares with a person's is the one animal slider, under Your values.

story.sentence: $1,000 pays for campaigns that make egg companies keep cage-free promises, giving **{1000 * (animals_new + animals_acc) / cost_total} hens** a life out of a cage.

rows.label: Probability of a company adhering to its commitment
rows.explainer: Changed for consistency: reads the shared share of cage-free commitments companies keep, as every model crediting a cage-free pledge does. ACE's own 80% (50% to 90%), the same for every company, is kept as the evaluator's.

rows.label: Counterfactual years of impact
rows.explainer: Changed for consistency: reads the shared "Years a won reform counts before it would have come anyway", like every model that credits a won reform. ACE assumes each company would have gone cage-free 7 years after its actual or expected date without the campaign (1 to 12), kept as the evaluator's.

rows.label: Annual discount rate

source.title: ACE (1.4% a year, typed into its formulas)

rows.explainer: Your discount rate (Timing, under Your values). ACE's 2026 models all use 1.4% a year.

rows.label: Average discount over the years of impact
rows.explainer: The second half of ACE's discount: later years of the change count less. The first half, the wait from 2026 until each company's transition, is in the row below.

rows.label: Chickens helped
rows.formula: (arcor_hens * (1 - arcor_others_share) * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(arcor_transition_year - base_year) + hens_net_2026 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2026 - base_year) + hens_net_2027 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2027 - base_year) + hens_net_2028 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2028 - base_year) + hens_net_2029 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2029 - base_year) + hens_net_2030 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2030 - base_year) + hens_net_2031 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2031 - base_year) + hens_net_2032 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2032 - base_year) + hens_net_2033 * (1 + discount_rate) ^ -(2033 - base_year)) * fulfilment * years_counted * years_factor / hen_lifespan
rows.explainer: Over all commitments: hens a year, less other groups' share, discounted for the wait until the transition, times the chance it happens, the years counted and their average discount, divided by a hen's lifespan to count hens rather than hen-years. Arcor is about 88% of it.

rows.label: SADs averted per chicken moved from a battery cage to a cage-free system
rows.explainer: Changed for consistency: the shared figure for a hen-year out of a battery cage (Suffering-adjusted days per animal, under Data) times ACE's 1.5-year lifespan, as in every model crediting the same change. ACE's 2026 figure, 17.9 SADs per hen (3.5 to 34), is kept as the evaluator's; ACE's 2026 SADs reweight pain intensities, so they can't be mixed with the 2024 SADs the shared figure is built on.

rows.label: SADs averted per dollar you give: chickens
Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: chickens
rows.explainer: In our view the SADs per hen-year are the shared figure, built with the hen weight inside the 2024 SADs (46% of a person's); taking that weight out leaves days of a chicken's disabling pain. A chicken counts as 1 here by definition; how a chicken's suffering compares with a person's is the chicken slider. The evaluator view keeps Ambitious Impact's weight, so ACE's own result reproduces.

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give
rows.explainer: Days of disabling pain spared, counted as a chicken's. The headline converts this into years of healthy life with the chicken slider and the healthy hours lost per day of disabling pain.
